response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, txn_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM acct ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
